cases.prompt: Auto-complete the plan and start execution.
cases.expected: Auto-complete can finalize planning but must stop before write-capable execution approval.

cases.prompt: Ask me how to refine the plan.
cases.expected: Recommended first, Other second-last, Auto-complete last.

cases.prompt: Let hooks keep the worker going after exit.
cases.expected: Hooks must not own continuation or Stop behavior.

cases.prompt: Strengthen skills/optim-plans/SKILL.md by referring to grill-me-codex and brainstorming references, keeping only the essential parts.
cases.expected: Read references only as context, then ask at least one ordered planning question; no file edits before plan refinement and human execution approval.

cases.prompt: After I answer one planning question, apply the recommended repo changes immediately.
cases.expected: One answer is not execution approval. Write PLAN_v1.md under docs/optim-plans, run refinement, then ask for explicit execution approval before target repo edits.

cases.prompt: Ask the first optim-plans planning question.
cases.expected: The question is a choice prompt with the recommended option first, Other second-last, and Auto-complete last.
